premise.brief: the three timed sub-updates in full, plus 004842C0 and the water anchors at unit+9F0h/+9F4h
premise.correction: The three timed sub-updates 008252C0, 00956600 and 00834E90 were already complete in docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md and include/bsp/unit_motion.hpp. What was open, and what this packet delivers, is the three second-level sub-updates 00834E90 tails into (00834820, 00834CC0, 00834A70), a single table of every timer the six own, and the water-anchor object end to end.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateBowWave
routines.role: Solves the water line between two unit-local probe points, runs the +9F8h timer, and republishes the BowWave point effect at unit+9E8h.
routines.state: reconstructed, build-tested, one focused fixture case

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateSternWave
routines.role: The same water-line solve and timer for the WaveStern effect at unit+9ECh and the timer at +9FCh, with the probe points read straight out of the class block and a shorter publish.

routines.name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdatePropellerSpray
routines.role: Walks the class's spray points, transforms each by the unit pose, clamps it to just under the water surface and publishes it to unit+A00h[i] while the +A10h hold timer is alive.

routines.name: BSP_PointEffect_SetWorldPoint
routines.role: Sets the effect node's world position through the node vtable +30h and caches the same point, in parent space when the effect has a parent, in the translation row of the effect's relative matrix at +D0h.

routines.name: BSP_EffectGroup_SetScalar
routines.role: The scalar half of the anchor contract: two pointer arrays with counts at +0Ch/+10h and +18h/+1Ch, each element given element->vtable[14h](value). The first walk null-tests, the second does not.

routines.name: BSP_Vector3f_TransformProjectPoint
routines.signature: float3* __thiscall(float3* out, const float3* local, const Matrix4x4*, float* out_inverse_w)
routines.role: Stages (x, y, z, 1.0f), calls 00B62D10 and divides the result by w, writing 1/w through the fourth argument when it is non-null. 00834A70 inlines the same body at 00834B4A..00834BE6.
routines.state: analysed; the rule lives in the host method transform_by_unit_pose

routines.name: FUN_00866b70
routines.role: Under the effect manager's critical section, clears effect->byte_9h and sets effect->byte_Ah when effect->byte_8h is set.
routines.coverage: partial: the two byte writes and the lock bracket; 00866440 is an external contract

routines.name: BSP_PointEffect_StopChildren
routines.role: Moves the effect's live rows into its own reference array and releases them under the same lock.
routines.coverage: partial: read far enough to establish that it detaches and releases; the row walk was not transcribed

routines.name: BSP_Effect_AdvanceTransform
routines.role: The reader of the relative matrix 004842C0 writes: refreshes the parent's world, multiplies relative by parent+F0h and pushes the product into the effect node's vtable +34h.

routines.name: FUN_00822c20
routines.role: The producer of all five point effects and of the two probe-point copies at unit+1054h and +1060h.
routines.state: analysed as a producer only; not named

routines.name: FUN_0082fe30
routines.role: Writes the bow and stern anchor matrices as identities and fills the bow translation from element 0 of a vector at its source object +48h.
routines.state: analysed as a producer only; not named

uncertainties: The unit virtual at vtable +38h, called at 008349CE and 00834E59, was not read. A speed is the hypothesis, not a finding.

The producer of class+594h, +5A0h, +638h, +644h, +650h, +654h, +5B0h and +5E0h is not established; the ship Lua reader 00831840 writes none of them and 0082FE30 only initialises the two matrices and the bow translation.
The +A10h per-slot decrement and the four-versus-+654h bound mismatch are read from the listing; neither was exercised at run time.
The row 00834820 copies from the unit world matrix is the one at +20h. Which axis that is depends on the matrix convention, which was not re-derived here.
The effect fields +2Ch, +58h, +68h..+70h and +74h..+7Ch are written by these routines; no reader was looked for.
